existing_cast_references.role_here: One of the six visiting storytellers and part of the revenge-site group. Receives the call directing them to Room205; later leads resistance to Hino and proposes a replacement member in one branch.
existing_cast_references.caution: Her hostile mistaken-recognition line1485 and unnamed betrayer at2300–2301 do not establish a reincarnation, possession, prior named assailant or a gender for that unnamed person. Preserve branch-specific speech rather than importing another route's culprit.

existing_cast_references.role_here: Sixth storyteller; participates with the revenge-site group, supports the replacement proposal, restrains Sakagami in one branch and panics during the later fight.
existing_cast_references.caution: Hino's explicit co-administrator name list870–872 omits Hosoda, despite Hosoda's participation. Do not remove him from the scene, invent a separate identity or silently add him to the quoted list. Existing visiting-student continuity remains in force.

existing_cast_references.role_here: Storyteller/co-administrator; physically restrains people and claims boxing experience.
existing_cast_references.caution: Boxing is explicit at2202–2203. Do not turn it into a school team, rank or professional occupation without further source evidence.

existing_cast_references.role_here: Storyteller/co-administrator; challenges Hino's rule-breaking, is intimidated, and later opposes him. His earlier Kokkuri-san story is referenced at1746.
existing_cast_references.caution: Hino claims he killed a romantic rival for Kazama at1059–1062. Neither rival nor romantic partner is named; do not assign the rival a gender or import a named partner from another version. Travel to Chiba is explicit, not proof Kazama resides there.

existing_cast_references.role_here: Storyteller/co-administrator; calls Hino the original site founder, treats violence as entertainment and frees Kurata under threat in the escape branch.
existing_cast_references.caution: Same-age remark1739 concerns recruiting Sakagami; do not use this script to overwrite her existing visiting-school/Gifu continuity or infer all participants attend one school.

existing_cast_references.role_here: Storyteller/co-administrator; says he administered the earlier chat that led to the revenge site. Carries a black device Sakagami thinks may be a stun gun.
existing_cast_references.caution: Chat administrator and revenge-site founder are distinct roles. The possible stun gun is a narrator inference, not a confirmed make/model or weapon use.

existing_cast_references.role_here: Newspaper Club vice president in existing lock; presents himself as revenge-site founder/administrator, manipulates Kurata's investigation and targets both younger club members. Others dispute his conduct and his sole-credit claim.
existing_cast_references.caution: Sakagami briefly wonders whether this is really Hino at617–621; the text gives no separate impostor/body-occupant reveal. Hino denies a sincere confession after Kurata says she rejected him; Sakagami interprets his anger as revenge for rejection. Keep these viewpoints distinct. His elite future and status claims2147–2158 are self-aggrandizing speech; combat training2321 is only speculation.

existing_cast_references.role_here: First-year Newspaper Club member; abducted/bound, framed through an assigned website investigation and endangered alongside Sakagami. Aspires to reportage journalism.
existing_cast_references.caution: A submitted murder request is acknowledged, but Kurata says Hino told her to use Sakagami's name as part of investigating an advertised revenge service. Do not make her a willing murderous client by dropping that explanation. Hino alleges she and Sakagami are dating; Sakagami denies knowing of such a relationship. Normal club friendship is explicitly retained at2468–2469.

Murder Club appears as music asset/alias, not established network name. Keep separate from Revenge Site.
Initial utility-knife recognition and possible stun gun remain qualified.
